The k=2 threshold is obtained exactly. Standalone checker passed 68 finite diagnostics; the proof is analytical.

value.rationale: A natural epidemiological question is whether equal basic reproduction numbers guarantee a stable comparative ranking of eventual epidemic burdens as transmissibility changes. The theorem gives a sharp finite upper bound depending only on the number of susceptibility classes and realizes all crossings with positive class rates, including an exact two-class threshold. It is a structural risk-ranking classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or isolated computation.
